name: Asian Television Network International Limited
summary: Asian Television Network International Limited provides specialty, pay television broadcasting, and advertising services primarily to the South Asian community in Canada. It offers 50 premium pay specialty television channels in 9 languages. The company also provides its flagship ATN-HD general interest service, and Bollywood movie channels, as well as sports, news, music, lifestyle, spiritual, and various regional language channels. In addition, it operates a South Asian radio service on satellite radio in the United States and Canada. The company offers its channels through cable and satellite companies. Asian Television Network International Limited was founded in 1971 and is based in Markham, Canada.
